_provenance: Hand-authored index of the four proposition-testing directions in Chapter 6 Testing the Theory; related_propositions resolves only to active P1–P4 records. Source headings and joins are checked against the chapter.
_intent: Index the four empirical tests, supported by shared measurement and experimental design and culminating in engineering routing, without reproducing proposition text.

kinds.label: Frontier
kinds.gloss: A moving line the book names and hands to a later program.

kinds.label: Measurement
kinds.gloss: An operationalization of governance into measurable quantities.

kinds.label: Dynamics
kinds.gloss: A learning / organizational feedback the book models but does not test at population scale.

kinds.label: Generalization
kinds.gloss: Whether the theory holds beyond the software case it was built on.

statuses.gloss: Named and operationalized in the book; the open part is extension, not existence.
Argued as a direction with a stated question; not yet answered.
Stated explicitly as a conjecture the book does not prove (dashed in the figure).

agenda.title: Testing Representation Leverage (P1)
agenda.one_line: Distinguish representation form from obligation completeness, and compare designed, recovered, and invented representations.

agenda.title: Testing Representation-Enabled Enforcement (P2)
agenda.one_line: Cross producer access to models with independent enforcement; measure escaped violations, false rejection, repair, and correct delivery.

agenda.title: Testing Governance Conversion (P3)
agenda.one_line: Track reuse of models, procedures, instructions, and controls, including originator independence, maintenance, retirement, and full cost.

agenda.title: Testing Governable Acceleration (P4)
agenda.one_line: Cross agentic capacity with specified environmental investments and assess durable delivery and review under fixed human attention.
